title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the 10 Major Cases and 50 Typical Cases of Judicial Protection of Intellectual Property by Chinese Courts in 2009
keywords_en: patent right; unfair competition; intellectual property rights
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the 10 Major Cases and 50 Typical Cases of Judicial Protection of Intellectual Property Rights by Chinese Courts in 2009

Fa [2010] No. 172

High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

In the past year, courts nationwide have concluded a large number of major, complex, difficult, and new types of cases in the fields of intellectual property rights and competition law. In order to actively carry out the activities of the 2010 National Intellectual Property Publicity Week, thoroughly implement the National Intellectual Property Strategy, further increase the publicity of judicial protection of intellectual property rights, fully demonstrate the achievements of the People's Courts in the judicial protection of intellectual property rights, and strive to create a favorable atmosphere conducive to the healthy development of the judicial protection of intellectual property rights by the People's Courts, upon the recommendation of various High People's Courts, and in consideration of the intellectual property cases tried by our court last year, our court has selected the 10 Major Cases and 50 Typical Cases of Judicial Protection of Intellectual Property Rights by Chinese Courts in 2009. The list of these cases and typical cases is hereby issued to you for reference by courts at all levels in their intellectual property trial work.

Sincerely,

April 14, 2010
